lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple horizontal rows of high-luminance circular pixel clusters distributed across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated luminance intersecting the horizontal spot rows to form a grid-like arrangement.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal linear features exhibiting a sharp vertical luminance gradient, located on the upper third of the visible flank.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A dark, elongated silhouette attached to the ventral region posterior to the pectoral fin, consistent with a parasitic or commensal organism.
other_distinctive_markers: A high-density cluster of smaller spots on the pectoral fin surface, distinguishable from the larger flank spot pattern.
